tools.name: search-huts
tools.description: Search Alpine mountain huts by country, region, name, access difficulty, minimum elevation or proximity to a point. Returns a page of hut summaries with slugs for get-hut.

tools.name: get-hut
tools.description: Get the full record for one hut: location, elevation, season, capacity, facilities, booking, contact, access routes, FAQs and photos with credits.

tools.name: get-hut-availability
tools.description: Free beds per night for one hut, where we hold current data. Most huts have none, and data that is too old or cannot be refreshed is withheld: the answer then says coverage "none" with a machine-readable reason, a plain-language message and the hut's booking link, which is a correct answer to pass o

tools.name: list-regions
tools.description: List the countries and regions in the directory with their slugs and hut counts. Call this first to find valid slugs for search-huts.

tools.name: list-guides
tools.description: List published route and region guides (e.g. Alta Via 1, Tour du Mont Blanc, Julian Alps), each with its URL and the slugs of the huts it discusses.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get-hut-availability" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
